description: Compare one institution with a peer group for one quarter: for each metric, the institution's value next to the peer median, quartiles, minimum and maximum, and its percentile and rank. The default peer group is every institution in the same asset-size band that reported that quarter; narrow it to one state, widen it to all sizes, or name the peers by CERT. Dollar amounts are in thousands; ratios are percentages.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number of the institution to compare, from fdic_search_institutions.

metrics.description: Up to 20 metric names (fdic_list_reference topic metrics). Omit for the default health set.

items.description: Metric name from the catalog, e.g. roa, net_income_ytd, cet1_ratio.

peer_asset_band.description: Peer size band by total assets: same (the band holding the institution's own assets, default), any (all sizes), under_100m, 100m_1b, 1b_10b, 10b_250b, or over_250b; fdic_list_reference topic peer_asset_bands gives each band's bounds. Not combinable with peer_certs.

peer_certs.description: An explicit peer list of up to 200 CERTs, in place of the band and state peer group — pass it without peer_asset_band and peer_state. Fewer than five peers still computes, with a notice.

items.description: FDIC certificate number of one peer.

peer_state.description: Limit peers to one headquarters state: a two-letter code, a full state name, or same for the institution's own state. Omit for nationwide. Not combinable with peer_certs.

report_date.description: Quarter to compare: a quarter-end date (2026-06-30), the same without dashes (20260630), or a quarter label (2026Q2). Omit for the latest quarter FDIC has published.

name: fdic_compare_peers

basis.description: point_in_time = balance at quarter end; quarter = that quarter alone; quarter_annualized = ratio from the quarter, annualized; year_to_date = accumulated since January 1; ytd_annualized = ratio from the year-to-date flow, annualized.

field.description: FDIC Call Report field code the metric maps to, e.g. ROAQ.

peer_count_with_value.description: Peers that reported the metric — the statistics cover only these.

peer_max.description: Highest peer value; null when no peer reported the metric.

peer_median.description: Median over the peers that reported the metric, in the metric's unit; null when none did.

peer_min.description: Lowest peer value; null when no peer reported the metric.

peer_p25.description: Peer 25th percentile (linear interpolation between peer values); null when no peer reported the metric.

peer_p75.description: Peer 75th percentile (linear interpolation between peer values); null when no peer reported the metric.

percentile.description: 0–100: the institution's percentile among peers, 100 × (peers below + half of peers tied) / peers with a value; null when the institution or every peer did not report the metric.

rank.description: Rank among the institution plus its peers with a value; 1 = highest value, ties share a rank. Whether high is good depends on the metric. Null when the institution did not report the metric.

rank_of.description: Size of the ranking: peers with a value plus the institution; null when the institution did not report the metric.

value.description: The institution's value, in the metric's unit; null when it did not report the metric.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the financials index (ISO timestamp).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `cert_not_found`: No institution record carries this CERT. `no_report_for_period`: The institution filed no Call Report for report_date (inactive, not yet chartered, or not yet published). `report_date_not_available`: report_date is after the latest published quarter. `invalid_state`: peer_state is not a state, DC, territory, or same. `conflicting_peer_filters`: peer_certs is combined with peer_asset_band or peer_state. `own_filing_incomplete`: peer_asset_band or peer_state is same (the band's default), and the institution's Call Report for report_date carries no total assets or state to resolve it from. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

asset_band.description: The size band the institution's total assets fall in; absent when the filing carries no total assets.

name.description: Name as filed on the Call Report for the quarter.

total_assets.description: Total assets for the quarter, USD thousands; absent when the filing carries none.

notice.description: Guidance when the peer group is empty or a metric has fewer than five peer values.

peer_certs_missing.description: Explicit peer CERTs that filed no Call Report for the quarter.

items.description: A peer CERT with no report for the quarter.

peer_group.description: How the peer group was built.

asset_band.description: Size band applied to peers; any when no size filter applied (including explicit peer_certs).

definition.description: The peer group in one sentence.

explicit_certs.description: True when peers came from peer_certs.

peer_count.description: Peers that filed a Call Report for the quarter, excluding the institution itself.

state.description: Headquarters state peers were limited to; absent for a nationwide group or explicit peer_certs.

report_date_defaulted.description: True when report_date was omitted and the latest published quarter was used.

title: Compare an institution with its peers
